practice.instruction: Use row operations to simplify the matrix until each pivot is 1 and all other entries in pivot columns are 0.
practice.selectRowOp: Select a row operation and enter the parameters.

validation.done: Done! The matrix is now in RREF — you can read the solution from the rightmost column.
validation.correct: Correct! Keep going — find the next pivot to eliminate.

rrefGuide.rule1: All zero rows are at the bottom.
rrefGuide.rule2: The first non-zero number in each row (the <1>pivot</1>) is <2>1</2>.
rrefGuide.rule3: Each pivot is to the right of the pivot in the row above.
rrefGuide.rule4: All other entries in a pivot column are <1>0</1>.
rrefGuide.tip: Tip: Work column by column from left to right. For each pivot, scale to make it 1, then eliminate all other entries in that column.

row_swap.label: Swap Rows
row_swap.explanation: Swap two rows to move a non-zero entry into the pivot position.

row_scale.label: Scale Row
row_scale.explanation: Multiply a row by a non-zero number to make the pivot equal to 1.

row_add.label: Add Row
row_add.explanation: Add a multiple of one row to another to create zeros below or above a pivot.
